PFL MENA Fight Night

Riyadh is hosting PFL MENA Fight Week, bringing together some of the region's top mixed martial arts (MMA) athletes for an exciting week of competition and fan engagement. The main Professional Fighters League MENA Fight Night will take place on Friday, 10 July, at the Global Theater in Boulevard City. Fighters will share their preparations before completing the official weigh-in ahead of the tournament. Held under the Professional Fighters League (PFL) MENA, the event follows the league's signature "win-and-advance" format, providing Arab athletes with a pathway to compete for championship titles while supporting the growth of mixed martial arts across the Middle East and North Africa. Summer Splash Running event

Summer Splash is a family-friendly running event taking place at ROSHN Front in Riyadh, featuring 2 km and 5 km run and walk categories. Organized by Race Arabia, the event combines fitness and entertainment with splash zones, water activities, and a lively community atmosphere, offering participants of all ages a unique summer running experience.
